Title: Getting Started on Your First Research Proposal
Description: A four-week online summer workshop for early-stage investigators and community partners with no prior NIH funding or grant experience, focused on developing NIH-style biomedical and health disparities research proposals.

Title: NIH Pilot Grants Proposal Preparation
Format: Weekly live Zoom sessions (day/time TBD based on participant availability)
Description: The second part of the Grant Writing Workshop Series. Provides support for individuals preparing to submit an NIH Pilot Proposal — for internal RCMI Pilot Project Program funding or external SuRE, K, R21, or other mechanisms. Highly recommended for all internal pilot submissions and mandatory for all first-time grant writers. Participants complete weekly assignments (about 12–15 hours/week) over the 3-month workshop, with the goal of a submission-ready proposal by January 2027.
Contact: Dr. Christine Hohmann (christine.hohmann@morgan.edu) or Dr. Shiva Mehravaran (shiva.mehravaran@morgan.edu)
